people.name: Ammon
people.line: An ancient nation and its capital city, enemies of Israel.

translations.web: The children of Ammon came out, and put the battle in array at the gate of the city; and the kings who had come were by themselves in the field.
translations.bsb: The Ammonites marched out and arrayed themselves for battle at the entrance to the city, while the kings who had come stayed by themselves in the open country.
translations.kjv: And the children of Ammon came out, and put the battle in array before the gate of the city: and the kings that were come were by themselves in the field.
translations.asv: And the children of Ammon came out, and put the battle in array at the gate of the city: and the kings that were come were by themselves in the field.
